turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friend says I look bored in interviews. I'm not, it's just my face.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, resting serious face. Body language can fix a lot of that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Like what? I can't just grin the whole time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No, but lean forward slightly when they talk, nod now and then, and smile when you greet them and when you're talking about something you enjoy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're probably snowed in all weekend and I need ideas to keep everyone sane.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ooh, can you just listen while I run through the choices? Then I'll ask what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a massive jigsaw in the cupboard, a thousand pieces, which would keep us busy but might cause fights.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could have a baking marathon, bread, cookies, the lot, as long as we don't run out of flour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The kids want to build an igloo in the garden, which sounds amazing until everyone's soaked and freezing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a full movie day with blankets, popcorn and a film each person picks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Mix them up. An igloo session in the morning while everyone has energy, then warm up with baking, and finish with the movie day. Save the jigsaw for whoever needs some quiet time.
